caption: Transfer entropy between M2 YoY growth and SPY returns (tercile bins, 500 permutations). The forward direction (M2 YoY growth → SPY) is NOT significant (p = 0.20); only the reverse (SPY → M2 YoY growth, p = 0.03) is — the same reverse-leading pattern the Granger test shows, now in a nonlinear information-flow check.
narrative_alignment_note: Two-bar TE comparison; reverse-only significance reinforces the Granger verdict.
